reason_codes.du: duplicate residual entry after the first occurrence of a valid node identity
reason_codes.iv: residual entry has no node object or no non-empty node identity
reason_codes.lr: member relevance score is below the frozen threshold
reason_codes.pc: otherwise eligible member is beyond MAX_POOL_NODES after relevance ordering
reason_codes.sj: strict structured supervision or monitoring journal

sel_shape.e: integer count admitted to the capped clustering pool
sel_shape.n: integer count of raw residual entries inspected
sel_shape.o: integer count of sampleable excluded nodes not represented in q
sel_shape.q: optional list of at most two [reason_code, content_gist] samples, each gist at most 24 characters, with no node identity
sel_shape.x: fixed seven-integer vector ordered by reason_code_order

wire_semantics.persistence: the exact response-shaped sel object is persisted inside recall_events.recall_map
wire_semantics.sample_order: reason_code_order, taking the first excluded unique node by original residual ordinal for each represented reason; increment o for every excluded sampleable node not represented after fitting

holdout_boundary.creation_rule: candidate-only recall-map events and AE journals with created_at strictly after the sealed candidate deployment instant
holdout_boundary.instantiation_rule: the deployment node must seal the candidate commit, selected_policy digest, host configurations, deployment instant, and journal roots before reading any candidate outcome
holdout_boundary.no_overlap: no event, transport session, session, or cache identity may occur in train, eval, and candidate_holdout more than once across those partitions
holdout_boundary.outcome_rule: no candidate outcome may be read before membership and hashes are sealed; evaluation uses the unchanged gate tools without refitting

availability.history: derived during map build only from already-matured recall_events
availability.level_schema: read from the candidate node's level at map build
availability.missing_value_policy: substitute the frozen organic-train mean for a genuinely unavailable selected feature; do not add a missingness feature
availability.no_history: known zero counts, zero streak, and zero rate, not missing

ballast_filter.evaluation_role: mandatory structural eligibility rule, never a fitted predictor or a score term
ballast_filter.fail_open: parse failures and near misses are eligible

fc.envelope: after one space or tab, parse the first line as JSON object; require non-empty string path and kind, string language, lowercase 64-hex sha256, positive chunk part/total with part <= total, and positive line first/last with first <= last
fc.forbidden_shortcuts: no path, project, host, emitter, task, or node-id lookup

sj.content_marker: first stripped line normalized by lowercase and hyphen-to-underscore is exactly [supervision_journal] or [monitoring_journal]
sj.schema_marker: one of context/provenance keys kind,type,lesson_kind,record_kind normalizes by strip/lowercase/hyphen-to-underscore to supervision_journal, monitoring_journal, execution_journal, or goal_tree_journal

forbidden_predictors_or_ties: node ids or hashes/surrogates of node identity
literal observed cluster labels or lookup tables
task names or project task metadata
current access_count, usefulness_score, last_accessed, or updated_at-derived usage
the current delivery outcome, future outcomes, or any outcome whose 24-hour window ends after the map-build instant
bans.narrow_nonpredictive_uses: node identity may only deduplicate entries, remain in the pre-existing medoid wire field, and support later outcome measurement; task/cache/session/source identity may retain existing cache partitioning and evidence-split roles but cannot change eligibility, score, threshold, ties, or enablement

cache_contract.cold_cached_equivalence: identical residual, node values, matured history, build instant, and corpus state produce byte-identical selection and ordering
cache_contract.history_scores: recompute on every build; do not store scores or low-relevance verdicts in the structure cache
cache_contract.if_score_memo_is_added_later: bind it to selected_policy_sha256, recall-event revision, history horizon, and next outcome-maturity instant; invalidate on any earlier boundary
cache_contract.policy_revision: include selected_policy_sha256 in any reusable structure revision and clear pre-policy in-process cache state at deployment
cache_contract.structure_cache: may reuse only clustering templates; recount against the freshly filtered and relevance-ordered pool before the existing coverage check

cluster_scoring.grouping: keep the existing four-stage cascade and label gate
cluster_scoring.medoid: keep the existing stage-specific medoid choice, but choose only among admitted members, so every delivered medoid clears the frozen member threshold
order: descending math.fsum(member relevance scores in original residual order) divided by member count
ascending best original residual ordinal, which is unique because clusters partition the pool
cluster_scoring.score_inputs: member relevance scores only; cluster size, stage, label text, task, host, and identity are not relevance features or tie-breaks

fit.threshold_fit: score every organic-train item, take the score at one-indexed rank ceil(0.20 * 3102) = 621 in descending order, and include every tie
fit.train_direction_constraint: each selected feature has positive consumed-minus-nonconsumed association in organic train, organic eval, and observed-map eval
fit.weights_rule: equal positive weight for all and only transferable decision-time features; no coefficient or threshold was optimized on eval labels

history_definition.consumed: the frozen node-id consumption outcome for that prior delivery
history_definition.eligible_prior_delivery: same node, prior delivery created before the current map-build instant, with outcome_end <= current map-build instant
history_definition.prior_consumption_rate: consumed / matured, or 0 when matured is 0
history_definition.prior_nonconsumption_streak_log: log1p(consecutive nonconsumed outcomes at the tail of matured history, ordered by outcome_end then delivery instant)

member_pipeline: inspect every residual entry and classify iv or first valid occurrence/du without using identity as a predictor
apply fc/ss/sj ballast eligibility before any pool cap
derive the five frozen decision-time features and compute S = sum_i((x_i - mean_i) / scale_i)
stable-sort admitted nodes by descending S then ascending original residual ordinal
classify admitted nodes after the first MAX_POOL_NODES=200 as pc
cluster and order the remaining sel.e nodes
selected_policy.nonconsumption_prior: positive, not negative: prior nonconsumed count and streak receive the same +1 standardized weight because their measured direction is positive in all three cohorts; treat them as exposure proxies, not evidence that nonconsumption is causally useful
selected_policy.recency_decay: none: node_age_log_days reverses from positive in organic train/eval to negative in observed-map eval, so age, freshness boosts, age penalties, time decay, and memory cleanup are outside this policy

rejected_features.content_context_provenance_shape: snapshot-only and not versioned; only the separately specified strict ballast eligibility classifier may read form/schema/provenance
rejected_features.recorded_delivery_scores: absent from all 686 observed-map eval items

ballast_diagnostic.role: structural eligibility sensitivity evidence, not a fitted score feature
